QuestInfo.name: Circling Around
QuestInfo.0: You got some information from #m310000000#, but it wasn't that much of a gain... How regrettable.
QuestInfo.1: Bring the intel you gathered from the people of #m310000000# back to #b#p1401001##k for processing.
QuestInfo.2: #p1401001# has a theory that the Black Wing officers have never shown themselves to the lower-ranking members. It would explain the disconnect.

0.0: I'm glad I made it out of there in one piece. At least the information on the mining operations was good...
0.1: I guess disguise is out of the question now. Every Black Wing member from here to Mu Lung will know me within the hour. I think it's time I try to find one of the officers outside of #m310000000#. #b#p1401001##k may be able to work that out for me.

yes.0: But you work with what you have, not with what you want! That's what I say. I'll get back to the #b#m150000000##k, kick my feet up, and let my employees do the work!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: All that work and I only get one useful piece of information....

1.0: Hey boss, I see you made it out of #m310000000# with your head attached. I bet you found lots of juicy intel!\r\n#L0##bUh, yes, about that... (You tell #p1401001# everything you know.)#l\n#k
1.1: Well, that was a bust, wasn't it? I was expecting you to get SOMETHING out of those watchmen... Actually, that gives me an idea. \r\n#L0##bWhat kind of idea? I thought this investigation was dead in the water!#l\n#k
1.2: Well, if the people on the ground floor don't know anything about the people up top, that means #bthe people up top are hiding something, probably about the Black Mage#k. I'd say there are only a few actual Black Wings members out there. \r\n#L0##bYou might be on to something. The watchmen I spoke to certainly didn't seem loyal to the cause...#l\n#k
1.3: Exactly my point. It's too bad #m310000000# is a dead end. You're gonna have to find a whole new batch of people to mine for intel...

yes.0: #b#p1401002##k got a hold of some new information. Maybe it's another lead on the Black Wings?
